items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: So he says, Cozy, come on get five pieces together and come on and replace Benny.

ctx.x: No small group, because it was, little scene where Billy Rose sold the Metropolitan Opera House and Benny Goodman had his five pieces or six, I just forget what it was, Red Norvo was in there and all these showgirls were around him. It was a beautiful scene. Well when Benny Goodman cut out, see the show wasn't a great hit but it

ran for a little while, so Benny Goodman got the best of it. About first six or eight weeks, months of it. So there were another four, five months of it to go, but Benny cut out because he had other commitments to do. So Billy Rose was around auditioning bands, but he couldn't find a band that could, that he liked. So he says, Cozy, come on get five pieces together and come on and replace Benny. I've been auditioning bands, and I don't have a band yet. So I wasn't worried about it too much because he's the…
How far apart were the two theaters?
